digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ, parent hierarchy reconciliation
propositions: When a child's direct parent cannot be represented in Jira due to type collapse (non-epic parent in epic-only project), an echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be appended naming the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key
The breadcrumb is emitted from the outbound comment differ and decorated with RECONCILER_MARKER and a stable identity tag to enable inbound suppression and dedup-once append
The breadcrumb walk identifies the nearest represented ancestor by traversing local_parents upward and checking binding_store for each candidate until finding a bound Jira key
If intervening ancestors are skipped because they lack bound keys, the breadcrumb body explicitly notes that intervening parent levels are not represented
No breadcrumb is emitted if no ancestor in the chain has a bound Jira key, or if the parent is absent, or if the parent type is epic
